SURFER QUANTGOLD · SWING BREAKOUT

GoldHunter historical gold swing breakout strategy

GoldHunter is the historical gold breakout EA. It looks for short-cycle XAUUSD breakouts across multiple levels, can place a series of orders as momentum builds, and adjusts exposure as volatility changes.

GoldHunterSurfer strategy family
01

Trading logic

The strategy monitors breakout levels during short gold price swings. When a range gives way to a fast directional move, its momentum module can trigger several orders in succession. Exposure is managed both per trade and across the resulting group of positions.

02

Risks & boundaries

A batch of fills can use margin quickly. The source describes 1%–20% as a stop trigger for a trade or trading phase. Gaps, slippage and liquidity affect realized losses. Position-scaling rules also vary across historical versions.

03

Operating requirements

The source describes an ECN account trading XAUUSD and reports daily volume in lots. A single batch can contain several orders, so the order count alone does not describe the margin it uses.
